# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

Authoritative hand-written sources, not owned by this generator: `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md` (mirrored into `CLAUDE.md` by `php artisan boost:install`) and the 15 glob-scoped rule files under `.ai/rules/`, indexed by `.ai/rules/index.md`. The patterns below are the ones observable in the code plus the tooling that enforces them.

### 1. Domain concepts are lookup tables, never PHP Enums

Every domain vocabulary — problem levels, component categories, link types, session durations, estimate modes, phases — is a seeded table row referenced by FK, so it carries `name`, `position`, `is_active` and copy that no Enum could hold.

- `app/` contains zero Enum classes and no `enum` column exists in any migration; `database/migrations/2026_08_22_210031_create_link_types_table.php` stores `slug`, `badge_label`, `gloss`, `position` — copy an Enum case could not hold.
- Constants that would be Enum cases live as class constants next to the code that owns them: `SessionCreator::DEFAULT_ESTIMATE`, the payload limits in `TrainingSessionUpdateRequest`. No model declares one today.
- The inverse also holds: a concept that is a single value with no copy, no ordering and no rows to seed does not earn a lookup table either — `training_sessions.show_connection_order` is a plain boolean column, and the legend copy for connection order is the `ORDER_NAME` / `ORDER_GLOSS` pair in `resources/js/canvas/legend.ts`. One client-side constant is allowed; a parallel client catalog is not (`.ai/rules/canvas.md`).
- Stated as a standing constraint in `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md`: generic Enum guidance must never justify creating an Enum where the schema defined a lookup.

### 2. Controllers authorize and delegate; nothing else

Each action is `Gate::authorize(...)` plus one service call plus an HTTP status. Bodies stay 3–8 lines.

- `TrainingSessionController::update()` — authorize, `SessionStateWriter::write()`, `response()->json([...])`.
- `BoardController::__invoke()` — `CurrentSessionResolver::resolve()`, `CatalogService::payload()`, `Inertia::render()`.
- `.ai/rules/controllers.md` bans `$this->authorizeResource()` (no `middleware()` on Laravel 11+ controllers) and forbids taking `user_id` from the client.
- Enforced by `phpstan.neon` level 7 over `app/` and by `pint.json` preset `laravel`.

### 3. Services are single-purpose and decoupled from the HTTP context

One class per use case, injected per-method when used once. They receive `User`/`TrainingSession`/arrays and return models — never views, redirects or flash messages, and they never touch `request()`, `session()` or `auth()`.

- `CurrentSessionResolver::resolve(User $user)`, `SessionCreator::create(User $user, ?int $problemId, ?int $durationMinutes)`, `SessionStateWriter::write(TrainingSession $session, array $payload)` all take their inputs as parameters.
- No interfaces exist for these four classes — `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md` forbids extracting a contract before a second implementation arrives.
- `app/Services/` scoped rules: `.ai/rules/services.md`.

### 4. Validation and normalization live in FormRequests, keyed on catalog slugs

`prepareForValidation()` repairs what is repairable before rules run; rules then compare against catalog slugs with `Rule::in`, never `Rule::exists` — a max-size payload would otherwise cost ~600 queries (`.ai/rules/requests.md`).

- `TrainingSessionUpdateRequest::prepareForValidation()` — negative estimate numbers become `0`, `null` text keys go back to `''`; nothing else is repaired.
- Rules that no built-in covers are private `Closure` factories on the request, named after the invariant: `notTheSourceOfTheEdge()`, `orderIsUniqueInTheDiagram()`, `knownChecklistItems()`.
- `Rule::in(Component::query()->pluck('slug')->all())` for `nodes.*.type`; `Rule::in(SessionDuration::query()->pluck('minutes')->all())` for `duration_minutes`.
- Limits are class constants in the request, not columns: `MAX_NODES = 200`, `MAX_EDGES = 400`, `MAX_LABEL = 60`, `MAX_NOTES = 5000`.

### 5. Per-user isolation always has two locks

An owner-scoped route binding removes the row from the request entirely, and the policy check runs anyway.

- `AppServiceProvider::configureRouteBindings()` resolves `{trainingSession}` via `TrainingSession::ownedBy($user)->findOrFail($value)` → 404 before the controller.
- Every `TrainingSessionController` action still calls `Gate::authorize(...)` against `TrainingSessionPolicy`.
- `TrainingSessionResource` deliberately omits `user_id`; asserted by `assertJsonMissingPath('data.user_id')` in `tests/Feature/Sessions/TrainingSessionCrudTest.php`.
- Rule of record: `.ai/rules/controllers.md`. Regression suite: `tests/Feature/Sessions/CrossUserIsolationTest.php`, `TrainingSessionScopeTest.php`.

### 6. Eloquent configuration goes in PHP attributes, not properties

Models declare `#[Fillable([...])]`, `#[Hidden([...])]`, `#[UsePolicy(...)]`, `#[ScopedBy(...)]` and `#[Scope]` on scope methods instead of `$fillable`/`$hidden` arrays or `AppServiceProvider` registrations.

- `app/Models/TrainingSession.php` — `#[Fillable([...])]`, `#[UsePolicy(TrainingSessionPolicy::class)]`, `#[Scope] protected function ownedBy(...)`.
- `app/Models/Component.php` — `#[Fillable([...])]`, `#[ScopedBy(OrderByCategoryPosition::class)]`; `app/Models/Phase.php` uses `#[ScopedBy(OrderByPosition::class)]`.
- `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md` requires the same for observers (`#[ObservedBy]`) and keeping `$fillable` in sync with every migration.

### 7. Catalog tables are read-only at runtime

Writes to any catalog model from an HTTP request throw; the seeder (console) is the only writer.

- `app/Concerns/ReadOnlyAtRuntime.php` boots `saving`/`deleting` guards that `throw new RuntimeException` unless `app()->runningInConsole()`.
- Applied by 11 models (`Component`, `ComponentCategory`, `LinkType`, `Phase`, `ChecklistItem`, `Problem`, `ProblemItem`, `ProblemItemType`, `ProblemLevel`, `SessionDuration`, `EstimateMode`).
- Seeders are idempotent `upsert` keyed by `slug` / `minutes` / `(phase_id, position)` (`database/seeders/PhaseSeeder.php`, `ChecklistItemSeeder.php`), so re-seeding never duplicates rows.

### 8. `resources/js/canvas/` and `resources/js/prancheta/` stay framework-free

The two TS cores hold all decision logic and are unit-testable under Vitest's `node` environment; the Vue layer only measures, binds and presents.

- Enforced from the PHP suite: `tests/Feature/Frontend/CanvasEngineTest.php` asserts no `canvas/` file contains `from 'vue'`, `from '@inertiajs`, `document.` or `window.`.
- `vitest.config.ts` runs only `resources/js/{canvas,prancheta}/**/*.test.ts` with `environment: 'node'`.
- `.ai/rules/canvas.md`: `CanvasEngine` is instantiated as `reactive(new CanvasEngine(...))`, so use TypeScript `private`, never `#private` fields — the Vue proxy breaks on them.
- DOM work is quarantined: the download step lives in `resources/js/lib/downloadFile.ts`.

### 9. Prefer derived state over stored flags

Anything that can be computed from the payload is computed, so no flag can drift out of sync.

- Current session = `MAX(last_opened_at)` per user (`CurrentSessionResolver`), never a stored pointer column.
- Save indicator = `store.isDirty` derived from the payload signature (`Autosave::chip` in `resources/js/prancheta/autosave.ts`; `.ai/rules/js-prancheta.md`).
- Edge numbering is the deliberate counter-example: it is **stored** on the edge (`edges[].order`), because the order a candidate wants to narrate is not derivable from the drawing. What stays derived around it is the invariant — `densify()` is the single exit point of every order mutation, so `{1..N}` is a consequence, not a flag to keep in sync (`resources/js/canvas/order.ts`).
- Legend = derived from the current diagram, no own state (`resources/js/canvas/legend.ts`).
- Phase slices = derived from `phases.weight` × chosen duration (`resources/js/prancheta/clock.ts::bounds`).

### 10. Comments are PHPDoc above declarations and WHY inside bodies

No `//`, `#` or `/* */` directly above a `class`/`function`; no narration of what the code does. In-body comments only explain non-obvious reasons.

- `app/Http/Resources/TrainingSessionResource.php` docblock explains why `#[PreserveKeys]` exists (`checks` would be reindexed otherwise).
- `database/migrations/2026_08_22_210054_create_training_sessions_table.php` explains why the table is not called `sessions`.
- Rule source: `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md`. Formatting enforced by `pint.json` preset `laravel`.

### 11. TypeScript style is lint-enforced, not conventional

- `@typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports` with `fixStyle: 'separate-type-imports'` and `import/consistent-type-specifier-style: prefer-top-level` — hence `import type { … }` lines throughout `resources/js/prancheta/`.
- `import/order` with groups `builtin, external, internal, parent, sibling, index` and case-insensitive ascending alphabetize.
- `@stylistic/padding-line-between-statements` forces a blank line around `if`, `return`, `for`, `while`, `do`, `switch`, `try`, `throw`; `curly: ['error','all']`; `@stylistic/brace-style: 1tbs` with `allowSingleLine: false`.
- Formatting: `.prettierrc` — 4-space indent, single quotes, `printWidth: 80`, Tailwind class sorting over `clsx`/`cn`/`cva`.
- ESLint ignores generated/vendored trees: `resources/js/{actions,routes,wayfinder}/**`, `resources/js/components/ui/*`, `bootstrap/ssr`, `public`, `vendor`.

### 12. Pest only, with datasets for repeated scenarios

- `tests/Pest.php` binds `TestCase` + `RefreshDatabase` to the whole `Feature` suite; shared helpers (`autosaveBody()`, `seedCatalog()`, `domainTables()`, `frontendSource()`) live there.
- Two-or-more identical bodies become a dataset with descriptive string keys — `tests/Feature/Sessions/TrainingSessionCrudTest.php` `->with(['abaixo do mínimo' => [15], 'entre as opções' => [50], …])`; route sweeps use `->with(['sessions.index', 'sessions.store', …])`.
- Inertia pages are tested as HTTP feature tests with `AssertableInertia` (`tests/Feature/Sessions/BoardPageTest.php`).
- `.ai/rules/feature.md`: any test hitting `/prancheta` must call `seedCatalog()`; the seed is never enabled globally.
